chosen.premise: When agitated, Koffing raises its gas toxicity, jets poison from its whole body, and can overinflate before exploding.
chosen.hook: Anger gives Koffing three ways to become more dangerous.
chosen.visualIdea: Koffing shifts through three escalating states: darker gas, body-wide jets, then extreme inflation.
chosen.note: One entry supplies a strong escalation sequence: higher toxicity, body-wide jets, overinflation, and possible explosion. It is specific, character-defining, and easy to animate.

candidates.premise: Koffing weighs only 1 kilogram, yet lighter-than-air poisonous gases keep it slightly airborne.
candidates.hook: Koffing weighs one kilogram—but it still floats.
candidates.visualIdea: A 1 kg weight drops on a scale while Koffing rises beside it, lifted by animated gas arrows.
candidates.note: The one-kilogram-versus-floating contradiction is exceptionally clear and fully supported, though it explains buoyancy more than it reveals an unusual behavior.

candidates.premise: Koffing mixes toxins with raw garbage, and higher temperatures make the resulting poison gas more powerful.
candidates.hook: Koffing doesn’t just store poison—it manufactures it from trash.
candidates.visualIdea: Trash and toxic droplets enter Koffing, swirl into a reaction, and emerge as a larger poison-gas cloud.
candidates.note: Turning raw garbage into poison gas is distinctly Koffing and highly filmable. The research supports the reaction and increased gas production, but “more powerful” slightly overstates the temperature detail.

candidates.premise: Koffing’s thin body makes its swirling toxic gas visible, but getting close can trigger coughing and tears.
candidates.hook: Koffing lets you see its poison—if you can stand being near it.
candidates.visualIdea: The camera zooms through Koffing’s thin skin to reveal swirling gas, then cuts to coughs and watering eyes.
candidates.note: The contradiction of visibly inspecting toxic gas while suffering immediate symptoms is distinctive and well supported. It is slightly less mechanically sharp than the escalation angle.

candidates.premise: Koffing’s internal gases expand in hot places, turning heat into a sudden explosion risk.
candidates.hook: Why is a hot day basically a countdown for Koffing?
candidates.visualIdea: A temperature gauge rises inside Koffing as its body expands, ending in a sudden warning-free blast.
candidates.note: The heat-triggered explosion is concrete and highly visual, but the core idea is fairly close to the broader “Koffing can explode” premise.

candidates.premise: Koffing remains a single Poison-type until a level-35 level-up transforms it into Weezing.
candidates.hook: Koffing’s two-body evolution happens at exactly level 35.
candidates.visualIdea: A level counter climbs from Koffing to 35, then the single Pokémon flashes into Weezing.
candidates.note: Level 35 is precise and easy to show, but evolution-at-a-level is a common Pokémon angle and the method comes from secondary research rather than the listed Pokédex entries.
